prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic documentary, abandoned aquarium ticket hall. An unmistakably adult archival filmmaker with an original facial identity, long dark wavy hair, and a dark blouse records a salt-stained route map on a tripod-mounted camera. The attached portrait is styling reference for long dark wavy hair and dark blouse; render an original adult face. An apparatus-bound phantasmagoria projection sequence: a projected sequence of spectral marine apparitions visibly advances from one form to the next. A visible lantern lens movable projector and operator establish the projection apparatus nearby. One bounded light cone connects the apparatus to the spectral image onscreen. Projected spectral edges visibly land on smoke wall or translucent screen tiles. Successive spectral images change scale or replace one another through apparatus movement in four phases. Operator apparatus audience side and projected apparition occupy distinct coherent depth layers in one frame. Four phases: compact jellyfish, unfurling bell, luminous tendrils, dispersed shoal afterimage. Empty corroded benches occupy the foreground, the operator and rig the midground, and the receiving tiled wall the background. Fogged aquarium glass, wet tile, cool cyan projection, muted amber lamps, wide three-quarter view, restrained grain, realistic optics.
